tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Board background; the game world shows through wherever a screen leaves it transparent.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panel fill (90% alpha). Pair with panel-border.

tokens.name: panel-border
tokens.usage: 1px solid border on panels, chips and inputs.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and panel.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, disabled text. 4.6:1 on panel.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selected item, primary button, focus ring, progress fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Damage, errors, destructive buttons. Never the only cue: pair with an icon or text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low resource, caution. Keep small; it is not the accent.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels over values and bars (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero numbers and the screen headline; one per board.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gap between bar segments.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels; overflow: hidden clips children to it.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels. Imports as effect: shadow(); keep to one layer on large panels.

board.note: Artboard size for a 1080p-first game UI; use 1920x1080 for 4K-first projects.
